en: The postcard features an old railway station labeled 'Priestewitz' on the main building. The scene shows several people standing outside the station, with railway tracks in the foreground and mature trees behind the station. The architecture suggests a small-town European station, possibly from the late 19th or early 20th century. The text 'Gruss aus Priestewitz.' appears at the bottom, and the publisher mark reads 'Brück & Sohn, Meissen.'
